snippet.title: Blood Sins Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!

Blood Sins will be featured in the June 2025 Steam Next Fest, running from June 9 to June 16.
Right after the event ends, on June 17, you can grab the full version! 🤘🏻🔥
